name: The Blood Covenant
overview: Scripture reveals that the blood covenant is foundational for atonement and the remission of sins, as life is understood to be in the blood which God has given to make atonement for the soul (Leviticus 17:11). The New Testament emphasizes that Jesus' blood inaugurates a new covenant, shed for many to bring forgiveness (Matthew 26:28; Mark 14:24; Luke 22:20). The necessity of blood for purification is underscored in Hebrews, affirming that without the shedding of blood there is no remission of sins (Hebrews 9:22), and that through Jesus’ blood, the everlasting covenant is established, securing peace and salvation (Hebrews 13:20).
